title: AI
intro: Connect AI to ask about your data in plain language: diary, finance, birthdays, websites, music, games. It also enables the morning digest in Telegram, the /ask bot command and diary summaries.
placeholder: Ask anything about your data… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
